admin.area_hint.assignment_queues: Work queues, delegation and out-of-office cover.
admin.area_hint.reason_codes: Codes users pick when they justify a change.
assignment.condition_desc: The rule applies only to records matching this condition. Leave empty for all records.
assignment.empty_text: Records are not assigned automatically; people with the permission can assign them by hand.
assignment.hint: When a record is created or a transition is performed, the first matching rule assigns it.
assignment.order_hint: Rules are checked from the top; the first that matches assigns the record.
builder.publish.status_mapping_hint: Choose where the records of each removed status move. They move when this version is published and the move is recorded in each record's history.
builder.publish.unassigned_records: {n} existing records have no status and move to the initial status.
building.blueprints.view_version_hint: The new version is taken from the view this blueprint was saved from.
delegation.admin_hint: Every delegation and out-of-office cover. You can set them only for users whose permissions you hold yourself.
delegation.from_hint: Leave empty to delegate your own work.
delegation.hint: Hand your work to a colleague for a period. They act on your behalf and every action records it.
delegation.title: Delegation
formconfig.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and _. Used in links and the API.
formconfig.subtitle: How records of this form move, who sees what, and how they are listed, shown and printed.
formconfig.title: Configure {form}
justification.active_desc: Inactive rules are kept but never ask.
justification.condition_desc: Change the requirement for records matching a condition, for example amounts above a limit.
justification.empty_text: Changes are saved without asking why, unless a field or group in the builder asks for a reason.
justification.hint: Ask users to justify changes: when they edit the form, a group or a field, enter or leave a status, perform a transition, delete, restore or reassign. Saved justifications cannot be edited or deleted.
justification.no_code_sets: No reason code sets yet. Add them under Admin Console → Justification reason codes.
justification.show_summary: Show a summary of the changes
justification.show_summary_desc: List the fields being changed, old and new values, above the reason box.
justification.wording_desc: Title and help text shown to the user, per language.
panels.empty_text: A record shows its form, with history, comments and attachments in tabs.
panels.hint: Panels arrange how a record is shown. Without panels a record shows its form.
panels.no_links: This form has no lookup to the current form.
panels.no_paths_text: Choose fields of this form or of the forms it links to.
panels.no_table_columns_text: The table lists each related record by its title only.
panels.title: Title
panels.via_hint: The lookup in that form that points to this one.
panels.visibility_desc: Show the panel only for records matching this condition. Leave empty to always show it.
previews.autofill_desc: When a record is picked, copy its values into fields of this form.
previews.default_card: Card shown when a record of this form is picked
previews.default_card_desc: Shown wherever someone picks a record of this form in a lookup.
previews.drawer_desc: Users can open the picked record in a side panel.
previews.hint: When a user picks a record in a lookup, a card shows chosen fields of it and can fill fields of the form being edited.
previews.lookups_desc: Give one of this form's lookups its own card and fill fields of this form from the picked record.
previews.no_autofill_text: Picking a record fills nothing in this form.
previews.no_card_text: Lookups show only the picked record's title.
previews.no_fields_text: The card shows the record's title only.
previews.no_lookups_text: Add a lookup field in the builder to configure its card.
previews.no_overrides_text: Each lookup uses the card of the form it points to, and fills nothing.
previews.overwrite_desc: Replace a value the user already entered. Off leaves filled fields alone.
print.default_desc: Used when a user prints without choosing a layout.
print.empty_text: Printing a record prints its form on A4 portrait.
print.hint: Users with the print permission print a record as a page or PDF. The default layout applies when none is chosen.
print.name: Name
print.no_sections_text: The print shows the whole form.
print.show_logo_desc: The system logo at the top of each page.
queues.active_desc: Inactive queues are kept, but their columns and claim expiry no longer apply.
queues.claim_timeout_hint: A claimed item returns to the queue after this time. Empty: claims never expire.
queues.columns_hint: Shown for each item in My Work, up to 12.
queues.hint: A queue gathers the work assigned to a role or department; its members claim items from My Work.
queues.members_hint: Work assigned to this role or department follows this queue's settings in My Work.
queues.no_forms_text: Add the forms this queue covers. For other forms, My Work shows its standard columns.
queues.title: Work queues
reason_codes.active_desc: Inactive codes are kept for past justifications but no longer offered.
reason_codes.code_hint: Letters, digits, - and _. Saved with each justification, so it cannot change later.
reason_codes.empty_text: Without reason codes, justification rules can ask only for a written reason.
reason_codes.hint: Codes are grouped in sets; a justification rule asks for a code from one set. Codes are deactivated, never deleted.
reason_codes.label: Label
reason_codes.new_set_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and _. Rules choose a set by this key.
reason_codes.requires_note_desc: The user must also write a note when choosing this code.
reason_codes.set_hint: A justification rule offers the codes of one set.
record_access.effect_hint.deny: Removes these records; a more specific rule can grant them back.
record_access.effect_hint.hard_deny: Removes these records for good; no rule can grant them back.
record_access.empty_text: Everyone who can open the form reaches every record.
record_access.explain_desc: Check which records a user reaches, and why.
record_access.hint: Without rules, everyone with the form permission reaches all records. A rule for a user overrides one for a role, which overrides one for a department; hard denies always apply.
sla.active_desc: Inactive rules are kept but start no timers.
sla.condition_desc: The rule applies only to records matching this condition. Leave empty for all records.
sla.empty_text: Records can stay in any status without a time limit.
sla.escalations_desc: What happens once the time has run out, in order.
sla.hint: Each rule sets how long a record may stay in a status, with warnings and escalations when the time runs out. SLA rules take effect when the form is published.
sla.no_escalations_text: When time runs out the record is only marked overdue.
sla.no_statuses: Add statuses in the Workflow tab first.
sla.notify_hint: Escalation notices are queued for delivery and recorded in the audit log.
sla.warn_hint: Optional. Marks the record as due soon.
sla.working_time_desc: Count only working hours of the calendar, skipping weekends and holidays.
views.blueprint_saved: Blueprint saved. Other forms can now create views from it.
views.column_chooser_desc: Users can show and hide columns for themselves.
views.default_desc: Used by anyone who has no other view granted.
views.empty_text: Everyone with access sees the standard list of the form's main fields.
views.global_search_desc: A search box above the list.
views.hint: Columns can show this form's fields, the record status, number and dates, and fields of the forms it links to.
views.in_queues_desc: Its columns appear for this form's items in My Work.
views.name: Name
views.no_columns_text: The view shows the form's main fields.
views.no_filters_text: Users can still search; they cannot narrow the list by field.
views.no_sort_text: Records show the most recently changed first.
views.publish_first: Publish the form before configuring its views.
views.quick_desc: Shown first, above the other filters.
views.row_options_desc: Actions in each row's menu, still limited by permissions.
views.show_totals_desc: A totals row for columns with a total chosen.
views.sortable_desc: Users can sort the list by this column.
views.visible_desc: Shown when the view opens; hidden columns can still be chosen by users.
views.who_hint: Grant who uses this view in the access matrix. Users without a granted view see the default view.
workflow.approvals_desc: The record moves only after the required people approve.
workflow.change_key_confirm: Links, saved filters and API calls that use the current key will stop working. Change it anyway?
workflow.check.dead_end: No way out, and not final
workflow.check.initial_count: The workflow needs exactly one initial status
workflow.check.no_entry: No way in, and not initial
workflow.check.unreachable: Can't be reached from the initial status
workflow.checks_ok: Every status can be reached and has a way forward.
workflow.condition_desc: The button shows only for records matching this condition. Leave empty to always show it.
workflow.confirmation_desc: Ask "Are you sure?" before moving the record.
workflow.conflict: Someone else saved this in the meantime. The latest version has been loaded; apply your change again.
workflow.empty_hint: Without statuses, records have no status and no transitions. The first status you add is where new records start.
workflow.final_desc: The process ends here; no transition leaves this status.
workflow.initial_desc: New records start in this status.
workflow.intro: Statuses and transitions take effect when the form is published. Drag from one status to another on the canvas to add a transition.
workflow.key_auto_hint: Follows the name until you save or edit it. Lowercase letters, digits and _.
workflow.key_locked_hint: Saved keys are used in links and the API, so they stay fixed.
workflow.name: Name
workflow.no_approvers_text: Add the people, roles or departments who decide.
workflow.no_transitions_text: Records stay in the status they start in until you add a transition.
workflow.outline_desc: The same workflow as a list, for the keyboard. Choosing an item selects it on the canvas.
workflow.permission_hint: Who may perform each transition is granted in the access matrix of this form.
workflow.publish_hint: Workflow changes take effect when the form is published.
workflow.remove_status_confirm: Remove this status and its transitions? Records in it are mapped to another status when you publish.
workflow.required_fields_hint: The move is refused until these fields are filled.
workflow.route_hint: Shown on the canvas. Re-route it there, or drag the arrow's end to another status.
workflow.route_pick_from: Click the status this transition starts from, or “Any status”.
workflow.route_pick_to: From {from}: now click the status it leads to.
workflow.save_failed: Could not save. Check the highlighted entries.
workflow.select_hint: Select a status or a transition to edit it. Drag from one status to another to add a transition.
